data.current_summary: Search Kalshi series, or recent trades by series or trader
data.current_description: Three modes. mode=title (default): free text → matching Kalshi series (ticker, title, category, volume) — use it to find the series_ticker for the other tools. mode=series: recent trades by named traders on that series ticker, with the settled P&L estimate or the current mark-to-market (at the bid/ask midpoint, or the last trade on a wide or empty book); a trade between two named traders is listed once for each, on opposite sides. mode=trader: a named trader's recent trades by nickname. `min_amount` filters by contracts per trade (0, 100, 500, 1000 or 5000). Requires a KalshiSpy API key.

Filter results by min_amount (contracts per trade: 0, 100, 500, 1000, or 5000). Requires Elite or Lifetime API key. Each trade between two named traders appears once per trader on opposite sides.

data.current_summary: Find Kalshi markets by title or keywords
data.current_description: Find Kalshi markets by title or keywords, the way the KalshiSpy app's search works: fuzzy title matching finds the market series (so a team, a nickname or an approximate title works), and keyword matching runs against market titles. WITHOUT an API key it returns SETTLED WINS ONLY: settled markets where KalshiSpy's roster of ID-verified, high-profit Kalshi traders held the winning side (wins only, never a hit rate). WITH an Elite or Lifetime API key the same call also returns OPEN markets in `open_markets`: roster positions from the live feed and named traders' recent trades on still-open markets, and it costs 1 unit of the daily quota. Always read `data.access`: it says which answer you got and, when a key was refused, why; relay that sentence rather than guessing. Call this first whenever the user names a market in words, send the words under the argument name this tool's own schema gives, and cite each market's kalshi_url. An empty list is never evidence that Kalshi has no such market. For more wins, follow `settled_wins.more`, which carries ready-made search_settled_wins arguments.

Empty results do not indicate market absence.

data.current_summary: Search settled Kalshi markets this trader roster won
data.current_description: Search KalshiSpy's archive of settled Kalshi markets where its roster of ID-verified, high-profit Kalshi traders held the WINNING side with positive net realized profit. Parameter and field names call these traders "whales" (whale_count, min_whales, sort=whales); in prose, call them the roster or the verified traders. Wins only: losses are not archived, so present results as "what this roster got right on markets like this", never as a hit rate. Use this BEFORE answering about any current or upcoming Kalshi market: search the same series_ticker (e.g. KXFED, KXNBA) or category and cite the comparable past wins — titles, settlement dates, trader counts and realized profit. Each result carries the Kalshi URL and a kalshispy.com detail URL you can cite. Default window is the last 90 days; widen with `from`/`to` (max 366 days). No API key needed.
